correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, s>=2, 1<=k<ns, all edges change exactly one distinguishable-token coordinate; every maximal clique is a unique full feasible coordinate fibre. Saturation inequalities yield L<=f<=U, and exact bounded-occupancy exponential-polynomial coefficients give V and M_f. The clique polynomial counts every higher clique once. Connectivity follows vacancy-mediated token moves and swaps; distinct maximal simplexes intersect in at most one vertex, so replacing each simplex by its incidence star yields a connected graph and first Betti rank B=1-V+sum(n-f-1)M_f with no higher homology. An explicit inequality proves L=U precisely at k<=s or k=ns-1 for n>=3; n=2 is one-dimensional pure. The checker enumerates all 45 test instances and independently recomputes the facet histogram and Euler ranks. The finite experiments are corroboration only; full capacity k=ns is excluded.
